spans.s: शृंखल m.n. 1. An iron chain; 2. any chain (lit. and fig.), कंसारिरपि संसारवासनाबद्धशृंखलाम् Git.G.iii.; 3. a chain fastening an elephant, स्तंबेरमा मुखरसृंखलकर्षिणस्ते R.v.72; 4. a chain worn round the waist.

शृंखला f. 1. An iron chain; 2. any chain (lit. and fig.), कंसारिरपि संसारवासनाबद्धशृंखलाम् Git.G.iii.; 3. a chain fastening an elephant, स्तंबेरमा मुखरसृंखलकर्षिणस्ते R.v.72; 4. a chain worn round the waist.
शृंखलक m. 1. A chain; 2. a camel.
शृंखलित a. (f. ता) Chained, fettered, confined.
शृंखलित a. (f. ता) Chained, fettered, confined.

शृंग n. 1. A horn, शृंगं स दृप्तविनयाधिकृतः परेषामत्युच्छ्रितं न ममृषे न तु दीर्घमायुः R.ix.62 (where the word is used in this sense and in the sense of ‘supremacy’), गाहंतां महिषा निपानसलिलं शृंगैर्मुहुस्ताडितम् Sak.ii., R.xvi.13; 2. the summit of a mountain, अद्रेः शृंगं हरति पवनः किंस्वित् Megh.i.14, R.xiii.26; 3. the summit of a building; 4. any point or projection; 5. a horn of the moon; 6. a horn used as a wind-instrument; 7. a syringe, वर्णोदकैः कांचनशृंगमुक्तैः R.xvi.70; 8. a lotus; 9. a mark, a token; 10. supremacy, sovereignty, R.ix.62; 11. excess of love.
शृंग-अट, -अटक (I) m. name of a mountain.
शृंग-अट, -अटक (I) m. name of a mountain.
शृंग-अटक (II) n. a place where four roads meat.
शृंग-अंतर n. the interval between the horns of an animal.
शृंग-उच्चय m. a lofty peak.
शृंग-ज (I) m. an arrow.
शृंग-ज (II) n. aloe-wood.
शृंग-प्रिय m. an epithet of Śiva.
शृंग-मोहिन् m. the champaka tree.
शृंग-वत् m. a mountain.
शृंग-वेर n. 1. name of a town; 2. ginger.
शृंगक m.n. 1. A horn; 2. any pointed object; 3. a horn of the moon.

शृंगार (I) m. 1. The sentiment of sexual passion (the first of the eight or nine sentiments in poetry- it is two-fold, viz., संभोगशृंगार and विप्रलंभशृंगार qq.vv.), शृंगारः सखि मूर्तिमानिव मधौ मुग्धो हरिः क्रीडति Git.G.i.; 2. love, passion, R.vi.12; 3. coition; 4. a dress suitable for amorous purposes; 5. marks on an elephant’s trunk made with red lead.
शृंगार (II) n. 1. Cloves; 2. agallochum; 3. undried ginger; 4. red lead; 5. a fragrant powder for the dress.
शृंगार-चेष्टा f. love-gestore, R.vi.12.
शृंगार-भूषण n. red lead.
शृंगार-योनि m. an epithet of the god of love.
शृंगार-रस m. the sentiment of love.
शृंगार-विधि, -वेश m. a dress suitable for amorous purposes.
शृंगार-विधि, -वेश m. a dress suitable for amorous purposes.
शृंगार-सहाय m. a confidant, an assistant in love-affairs.
शृंगारित a. (f. ता) 1. Affected by love; 2. adorned, decorated.
शृंगारित a. (f. ता) 1. Affected by love; 2. adorned, decorated.
शृंगारिन् m. 1. A lover; 2. an elephant; 3. a ruby; 4. dress, decoration; 5. pieces of areca-nut with other spices folded in a betel-leaf.
शृंगि (I) m. Gold for ornaments.
शृंगि (II) f. The sheat-fish.
शृंगी f. 1. Gold for ornaments; 2. a kind of poison; 3. the sheat-fish.
शृंगिक n. A kind of poison.
शृंगिण m. A ram.
शृंगिणी f. 1. A cow; 2. a kind of jasmine.
शृंगिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Horned; 2. peaked.
शृंगिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Horned; 2. peaked.
शृंगिन् (II) m. 1. A mountain; 2. an elephant; 3. a tree; 4. an epithet of Śiva; 5. name of an attendant of Śiva.
शृंगी-कनक n. gold for ornaments.
सृंका f. A kind of garland made of jewels.
सृंजय m. pl. Name of a people.
